text: When told that the one true statement in the world is "God is love," one character in this work replies, "What is God? What is love?" Another character in this work lists his avocation as "being alive" and his principal occupation as "being dead." A doctor in this novel who used to work for the Nazis will, working night and day, have saved and let die equal numbers of people by the year 3010; that doctor works for a hospital founded by Julian Castle. A holy book beginning "All of the true things that I am about to tell you are shameless lies" and sacred texts in the form of calypsos are used by a religion in this novel called Bokononism, which is sweeping San Lorenzo. In this novel, the dictator Papa Monzano is killed, and the world's oceans are frozen, by an invention of Felix Hoenikker For 10 points, name this Kurt Vonnegut novel that introduced ice-nine.

text: He wrote a janitor who watches a high-school graduation in Valedictory, while he wrote about a dog in The Voice of Bugle Ann. His poetic works include Turkey in the Straw and a verse novel about three discharged soldiers, Glory for Me, which became the basis of the movie The Best Years of Our Lives. He wrote about gangsters in Chicago in his first novel, Diversey, while his historical fiction includes a novel about Gettysburg, Long Remember, and such period novels as The Romance of Rosy Ridge and Arouse and Beware. He also wrote Spirit Lake and Valley Forge, but is best known for a 1955 novel about a prison. FTP, name this American author who won a Pulitzer Prize for Andersonville.

text: One figure in this work is known as "Indignation" and is especially indignant about the way his daughter Minerva was treated. Another figure in it, Zenas, had his life changed after he read Dr. Weese's advertisement, which led him to realize that he would die young. It ends with an epilogue in which Yogarindra, Loki, and Beezlebub create men from earth after Beezlebub plays a game of checkers with God. It also contains a mock epic that tells of the fight between liberals like Carl Hamblin and conservatives like Christian Dallman. Sexsmith the Dentist believes that "a moral truth is a hollow tooth / Which must be propped with gold," while other parts describe Mayor A. D. Blood and Thomas Rhodes. Opening with a verse about "Elmer, Herman, Bert, Tom, and Charley," who are sleeping on "the hill," FTP, name this collection of dramatic monologues by Edgar Lee Masters.

text: A feud with Paklin causes the protagonist to buy a pricey ticket to the play "Don't Get Into Another Man's Sledge" and lodge with the Sipiagins, where Kallomeitsev challenges his lack of bowing. This novel opens as Ostrodumov recounts a letter instructing him to kill an unreliable agent. The protagonist eventually kills himself with a revolver in front of an apple tree, but the shot is not clean, and he laments "Even here I was incompetent!" Markelov and Mashurina join Vasilii Nikolaevich's revolutionary movement, a thinly disguised reference to the Nechaevists, and the democrat Solomin marries Marianna after the suicide of the revolutionary Nezhdanov. For ten points, name this novel by Ivan Turgenev which was "upturned" in a Sholokov title.
